title: GLM-Legal
summary: GLM-Legal is a specialized large language model from Z.ai (Zhipu AI) fine-tuned for legal domain tasks. The blog post details its training approach, benchmark performance on legal reasoning and document understanding, and applications such as contract analysis and legal consultation. The Hacker News discussion (634 points, 349 comments) debates its capabilities, comparisons to general-purpose LLMs, and implications for legal practice.
